# utekos-ai-context

> AI context bundle for the Utekos brand. Contains curated LangSmith / Deep Agents documentation mirrors and Spor design tokens. Agents referred to this repo should use this file as the sitemap to locate documentation and sources. All paths are relative to the repository root.

## Start Here

- [Context bundle index](docs/langsmith/index.md): Read-first list, operating rules, MCP profiles and canonical tools, verification baseline, critical prohibitions
- [Upstream docs index](docs/langsmith/llms.txt): Pointer to the complete LangChain reference documentation index (reference.langchain.com/llms.txt)

## Deep Agents SDK (deepagents, OSS)

- [Deep Agents overview](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/Overview.md): Core capabilities — execution environment, context management, delegation, steering
- [Quickstart](docs/langsmith/get-started/QuickStart.md): Build your first deep agent with planning, filesystem tools, and subagents
- [Subagents (synchronous)](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/SubAgents.md): Delegate work and keep context clean with the `subagents` parameter
- [Async subagents](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/async-subagents.md): Background subagents that run concurrently with the supervisor
- [LangSmith JS/TS client SDK](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/langsmith-sdk-client.md): TypeScript client for the LangSmith platform

## Deep Agents SDK — API Reference (JavaScript)

- [deepagents package](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/deepagents.md): Full package reference with README
- [deepagents package (short)](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/deepagent.md): Compact class/interface/type listing
- [Agent / createDeepAgent](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/agent.md): Main entry point, CreateDeepAgentParams, DeepAgent, SubAgent types
- [Backends](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/backends.md): StateBackend, StoreBackend, FilesystemBackend, CompositeBackend, BaseSandbox
- [Backends guide](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/backends.mdx): Choosing and configuring backends
- [BackendFactory](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/BackendFactory.md): Factory type for creating backend instances
- [Middleware](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/metadata.md): createFilesystemMiddleware, createSubAgentMiddleware, createMemoryMiddleware, and more

## Deep Agents Code (dcode terminal agent)

- [Overview and quickstart](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/code/overview.md): Install, provider credentials, launch
- [Memory and skills](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/code/memories.md): AGENTS.md files, auto-saved memories, reusable skills
- [Remote sandboxes](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/code/sandbox.md): LangSmith, AgentCore, Daytona, Modal, Runloop, Vercel sandboxes
- [Subagents in dcode](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/code/subagents.md): Define subagents as AGENTS.md files with YAML frontmatter
- [Reference: configuration](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/configuration.md): Model provider configuration
- [Reference: model providers](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/model-providers.md): Provider packages and compatible APIs
- [Reference: MCP tools](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/mcp-tools.md): Load tools from MCP servers
- [Reference: app data](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/app-data.md): MCP tools and app data
- [Reference: memory and skills](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/memory-and-skill.md): Persistent memory reference
- [Reference: remote sandboxes](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/remote-sansboxes.md): Sandbox provider reference
- [Reference: subagents](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code/subagents.md): Subagent definition reference
- [Reference: agent](docs/langsmith/deep-agents/reference/code.md): createDeepAgent reference (dcode variant)

## Managed Deep Agents (LangSmith-hosted, private beta)

- [Quickstart](docs/langsmith/managed-deep-agents/quickstart.md): Create an agent with the CLI or SDK, then run it
- [CLI reference](docs/langsmith/managed-deep-agents/CLI.md): deepagents-cli commands, project files, deploy behavior
- [SDK](docs/langsmith/managed-deep-agents/SDK.md): Threads, runs, and streaming with Python/TypeScript SDKs
- [Run an agent](docs/langsmith/managed-deep-agents/run-agent.md): Create threads and stream runs
- [Deploy an agent](docs/langsmith/managed-deep-agents/deploy-managed-deep-agent.md): Full deploy workflow — project files, MCP tools, subagents, backends, REST API
- [Connect MCP tools](docs/langsmith/managed-deep-agents/connect-tools.md): Register and connect MCP servers with per-user OAuth
